status: PROPOSAL, UNRUN. Nothing is launched by this branch; the parent owns resources, locks, timing and authorisation.
purpose: Close the one gap the retained #275 capture leaves for the affine local stage: the #276-validated polynomial fit needs observations from the 3x3 lattice, and only patch (2,1) was captured.

retained_sufficient_for_patch_2_1.evidence: attempt02: reconstructed patch input equals the captured iteration-1 input with relative L2 (excluding DC) <= 2.1e-5 for all frames of both backends; seven mutants >= 0.24; effect of native-versus-reconstructed input on the fixed-template maximum <= 0.001 px
retained_sufficient_for_patch_2_1.conclusion: no pre-crop or pre-shift capture is needed: the global iteration-1 input plus the backend's own state/global.txt determine the patch input

smallest_missing.rationale: MC_CCF_PATCH selects one patch per process in the #275 overlay; no source change is required, so the 16 runs reuse the verified #275 binaries. A one-process-per-backend variant would need an overlay change and a fresh exact-SHA build, which is more work and more new evidence than 16 short runs.

reuse.retained_scratch: /mnt/clathrin/alex-motioncorr-residual-ccf-20261022-805d9de2 (4GPUs; hash-verify before use; if absent, rebuild from the archive and overlay under the build lock, parallelism <= 2, which is a new build and needs its own receipts)
reuse.fixture: affine.mrcs/.star from the #275 fixtures, MANIFEST sha256 9697c20314d3c0ea4496d4747ad14cbb3088e4e2488b7fccad05ff5f88ad02dc

argv_template: as docs/post_rc0/s1/residual_ccf_20261022/run.py at 6ae48678: BINARY --i affine.star --o OUT --use_own --j 1 --patch_x 3 --patch_y 3 --bin_factor 1 --seed 1 --skip_defect --save_noDW --first_frame_sum 1 --last_frame_sum 5 --skip_logfile [--gpu 0]; env MC_CCF_CAPTURE, MC_CCF_STATE, MC_CCF_PATCH=<iy,ix>; cwd fixtures; numeric threads 1
capture_per_process: c1 (global, redundant), c2 (selected patch): weight, per-iteration input/map/candidate/before/after, reference, spectra
estimated_volume: about 2 MB per process, about 35 MB total
resources: parent-coordinated: CPU runs under the 8-CPU cap, GPU runs on one idle device selected by UUID under its correctness lock held through final health; no timing claim
acceptance_of_the_capture: each process exits 0; log shows the selected patch and its iteration RMSD lines

final STAR and trajectories of every new run equal the #275 affine capture-on run byte-for-byte after output-prefix normalisation (the patch selector does not enter the numerics); a difference is a stop condition
for patch (2,1) a repeat is not needed; its existing capture is the control

then_analysis.oracle: generalise attempt02 over the patch window (same frozen controls and mutants per window; geometry gate G-E per patch)
then_analysis.fit: build the observation table (accepted patches only, rows = frame, patch centre, state recentred to frame 0) from the captured states and acceptance; feed it to the #276 host fit oracle path only if at least four patches are accepted and cover the lattice; otherwise UNRUN
then_analysis.field_metric: the unchanged #267/#273 checker on the fitted field; no new gate

stop_conditions: GPU not idle or lock busy: stop and report, no blind retry

not_included_with_reason.observation_table_overlay: would change source; derivable from per-patch states and logs
not_included_with_reason.other_cases: noisy and pedestal need their own manifests; not generalised from this affine patch
